nodes.label:
Agent Produces
a Draft
nodes.title: Agent Produces a Draft
nodes.info: Any of the seven agent types covered in this chapter, producing any kind of draft output.

nodes.label:
Passes Guardrail
Check?
nodes.title: Passes Guardrail Check?
nodes.info: An automated check for the club's fixed limits, such as never naming a specific student in a group message. It runs before a human ever sees the draft.

nodes.label:
Automatic Rewrite
Required
nodes.title: Automatic Rewrite Required
nodes.info: The draft never reaches a human reviewer in this form; the agent must produce a new draft. Both a guardrail failure and a quality failure land here.

nodes.label:
Human Applies
Quality Check
nodes.title: Human Applies Quality Check
nodes.info: A person runs the short repeatable checklist: accuracy, tone, no inappropriate student mentions, matches club voice.

nodes.label:
Quality Check
Passes?
nodes.title: Quality Check Passes?
nodes.info: The reviewer's honest judgement call, not a rubber stamp. A reviewer who never rejects anything is not reviewing.

nodes.label:
Human Approves
and Sends
nodes.title: Human Approves and Sends
nodes.info: The single moment a person, not the agent, actually causes the message to reach a family.

nodes.label: AI Agent Oversight
nodes.title: AI Agent Oversight
nodes.info: A periodic separate check -- monthly spot-checks of already-sent messages -- that catches drift the per-message steps might miss over time.

nodes.label:
Family Receives a
Human-Approved Message
nodes.title: Family Receives a Human-Approved Message
nodes.info: Every message a family sees passed through this exact workflow, regardless of which agent drafted it.
